description: Final statutory TILA-RESPA Integrated Disclosure (TRID) Closing Disclosure or binding Schedule B closing fee addendum setting authoritative settlement terms, origination charges, and rate-lock extension fees at loan closing. Where to read: Identified by the "Closing Disclosure" banner on Page 1 ("This form is a statement of final loan terms and closing costs") or a signed "Schedule B Fee Addendum / Closing Cost Details" table on Pages 2-4. Distinguish from: Do NOT confuse with an initial TRID Loan Estimate ("Loan Estimate" header), a non-binding CRE Term Sheet, or a Credit Agreement (`cre-credit-agreement`) whose preliminary fee estimates are superseded at closing.

issuer.description: Settlement agent, lender, or issuing mortgage institution.

loan_amount.description: Final binding principal loan amount at settlement in the disclosure's currency. Where to read: Page 1, Loan Terms table, first row ('Loan Amount'). Distinguish from: Do NOT extract 'Cash to Close', 'Sale Price of Property', or 'Total of Payments' from Page 5.

appraised_value.description: Appraised collateral value the lender relied on at closing, when the disclosure restates it. Where to read: Page 1, Closing Information block ('Appraised Prop. Value') or the Schedule B collateral summary row. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract 'Sale Price' or 'Estimated Prop. Value'; the certified valuation itself lives in the appraisal (`mai-appraisal`), which stays authoritative for collateral value.

origination_fee.description: Binding total origination and rate-lock extension fee charged by the lender at closing, including any Schedule B rate-lock extension override. Where to read: Page 2, Closing Cost Details, Section A ('A. Origination Charges' total) or the signed Schedule B Fee Addendum override row if attached. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract the superseded base origination fee from an earlier Loan Estimate or Term Sheet (`cre-credit-agreement`), and do NOT extract Section B ('Services Borrower Did Not Shop For') or Total Closing Costs (J).

annual_debt_service.description: Total annualized principal and interest debt service obligation. Where to read: Page 1, Projected Payments table or Debt Service Summary schedule. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract a single month's escrow or HOA payment.

interest_rate.description: Final locked annual note interest rate as printed (e.g. 6.125%). Where to read: Page 1, Loan Terms table, 'Interest Rate' row. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract APR (Annual Percentage Rate) from Page 5.

currency.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in the disclosure. Where to read: Header currency symbol or explicit ISO currency notation (default USD for US TRID). Distinguish from: Do NOT return currency symbols like '$'—normalize to ISO 4217 (e.g. USD).

effective_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the closing disclosure and loan terms take effect. Where to read: Page 1, Closing Information block, 'Closing Date' field. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract 'Date Issued' or 'Application Date' when 'Closing Date' is printed.
